root_idea.summary: The root has a central orientation toward truthful, expansive goodness and beneficent conduct, alongside distinct branches for vocal imitation, land opposed to sea, and wheat or vegetation.
root_idea.development: The moral sense develops through the idea of breadth or expansiveness into abundant goodness, obedience, kindness, and truthful fulfillment. The lexical tradition also preserves separate sound, land, and plant branches rather than deriving every usage from one direct meaning.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The inflected imperfect Quran lemma is normalized to the Form I perfect citation form بَرَّ.
Distinct nominal/adjectival Quran form with both land and moral or beneficent uses.
Distinct verbal-noun-derived nominal headword meaning comprehensive righteousness and goodness.

senses.definition: To do good and act with piety; to treat someone kindly and beneficently.
senses.usage_conditions: Used absolutely for good conduct and transitively for kind treatment; the Quranic forms are active imperfects.

senses.definition: Land or dry, open country, as opposed to the sea.
senses.usage_conditions: Used in the Quranic land-and-sea contrast and for the terrestrial or open expanse.

senses.definition: Righteous, pious, and morally upright; substantively, a righteous person or people.
senses.usage_conditions: The plural أَبْرَار denotes the righteous generally. The Quranic بَرَرَة refers to angels and is treated in the lexical discussion as the stronger plural form.

senses.definition: Dutiful, kind, and beneficent in conduct toward parents, kin, or others; as the divine epithet al-Barr, supremely benign or merciful.
senses.usage_conditions: The human use describes benevolent treatment, while the divine use is a Quranic epithet expressing abundant mercy and beneficence.

senses.definition: Righteousness and comprehensive goodness: obedience to God, sound belief, prescribed duties, fidelity, and good works, including kind treatment.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic usage presents birr as more than a nominal ritual orientation: it encompasses belief, duties, charity, patience, and other approved conduct.

senses.definition: Good or benefit, including the good of worldly life and the hereafter; in a reported Quranic interpretation, Paradise.
senses.usage_conditions: This extension is preserved as a reported Quranic interpretation in the lexical evidence; no modern verse location is assigned to the historical citation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be true or veracious in speech or in an oath.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with sayings, statements, and oaths.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a deed or pilgrimage, to be performed sinlessly, accepted, or rewarded.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional description of an approved deed or pilgrimage and its favorable outcome.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a commodity, to be easy to sell and to procure gain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative commercial use describing an article that recompenses the seller's care.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of God toward a person, to show mercy or recompense and reward obedience.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive theological or figurative use distinct from the human subject's piety or kindness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To drive or call sheep or goats.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized pastoral use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To treat another with reciprocal kindness, affection, gentleness, and regard for his circumstances.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form III expresses mutual or reciprocal beneficent treatment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To carry out a saying or oath truthfully, or to cause an oath to be verified.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The subject may perform a statement or oath truly; God may be said to verify an oath.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To assent or consent to another person's conjurement or oath.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized construction concerning assent to a sworn appeal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To overcome or subdue; by extension, to prevail in evil or transgress.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The transgressive use is an extension from prevailing over others and is not a Quranic meaning of the supplied form group.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To ride or journey upon the land.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Opposed to journeying by sea.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cultivate or affect piety and to abstain from crime or sin.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form V expresses adopting or endeavoring to characterize oneself by birr.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To practice mutual birr: reciprocal kindness, goodness, affection, and gentle regard.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal Form VI construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To talk profusely and noisily, cry out, or speak confusedly, often with anger or aversion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The sense concerns clamorous or unprofitable speech.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a goat, to cry or utter cries when excited by desire for a female.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An animal vocalization distinct from human clamorous speech.

other_classical_meanings.definition: True or veracious.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival or substantive use concerning a person, saying, or oath.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Open or exposed ground outside a house or town, including elevated ground open to view.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in contrast with shelter, concealment, or an enclosed place; some later expressions are marked as less characteristic by the lexical authorities.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Publicity or openness, as opposed to concealment or secrecy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of being out in the open.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Wheat or wheat grain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The singular grain is بُرَّةٌ; the word is also used for wheat as a substance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A gratuitous gift, favor, bounty, or benefit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A substantive use emphasizing a benefit bestowed rather than moral conduct itself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Religious obedience or an incumbent duty, including pilgrimage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Classical specialization of comprehensive goodness, retained separately from the Quranic form's broader definition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The heart or mind.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare substantive use in expressions concerning inner composure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A call or sound associated with driving or calling sheep or goats.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A sound-imitation branch also reflected in related vocalization terms.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A rat or small animal resembling a rat; also the young of the fox.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare zoological use with several reported species identifications.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The fruit of the arak tree.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A collective noun for the fruit, with the lexical discussion distinguishing stages or forms of the fruit, including its first appearance, sweetness, hardness, and berry or cluster size.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A good, sweet, pleasant, or agreeable word, expression, or saying.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to speech or an utterance; the sense is associated with benevolent regard or conduct.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of or belonging to the land or desert; wild, uncultivated, or produced in the desert.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A relational adjective and its related desert-land nouns; distinct from the Quranic nominal headword بَرّ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: External, outward, apparent, or public.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of what is outward as opposed to the inner or hidden state.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The Berber peoples, especially inhabitants of the Maghrib and related regions.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A foreign ethnic designation treated as Arabicized in the lexical discussion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who talks much, vociferates, or speaks confusedly and unprofitably.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An agent noun related to clamorous speech.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A lion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative designation attributed to the noise, anger, and aversion associated with the animal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bucket that makes a noise in the water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A descriptive use based on sound.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Coarsely ground wheat or wheat flour.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A prepared wheat product.

other_classical_meanings.definition: More or most distant in the desert with respect to habitation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare comparative or superlative use; the lexical evidence rejects an otherwise possible analogical moral interpretation as its attested sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who overcomes.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An active participial use related to prevailing over another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A prudent or sound manager who keeps something under control.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized transitive construction meaning one who manages or regulates a matter well.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a pilgrimage, sinlessly performed, accepted, approved, and rewarded.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional blessing and description of an accepted pilgrimage, sometimes associated with feeding people and pleasant speech.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a sale, executed truly and honestly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive-participial use applied to an honestly completed transaction.

Desert or waste in the Quranic land-and-sea contrast.

Open country opposed to settled or riverside towns.
Outside or exposed area beyond enclosure.
Birr as expansive or comprehensive goodness.
Goodness, religious duty, fidelity, favor, and benefit branches.
Good as a substantive and worldly or eschatological good.

Relational adjective of land versus sea.

cautions: The Quranic imperfect lemma تَبَرُّوا is presented under the normalized Form I citation form بَرَّ.
The nominal headword بَرّ has distinct Quranic land, righteous, and beneficent or divine uses; these are not treated as contextual variants of one translation.

A historical Quran citation in the lexical evidence is retained only as a reported interpretation and has not been converted into a modern verse location without an independently matching QAC occurrence.
